messages:
Sam: tiny follow from the morning deploy 1. Postdeploy synth for the routing changes shows a slow degradation on the KV-cache warmup probe. p95 drifted from 80ms to 240ms over 10 minutes.
Sam: attached logs from synth-run: `kv-warmup -> GET /v1/cache/health 200 OK` but backend latency climbs.
deploy-bot: Canary for v2026.03.21-rc4 rolled to US-West and EU1 at 1767899900.
canary-bot: KV warmup probe metrics: initial p95 85ms -> 240ms at +10m. error rate steady at 0.02%.
Priya: curious if prefix cache misses are increasing. any recent TTL or shard changes?
sre-oncall: Query counts per shard show a rebalancing event on cache service 1767899955 which coincides. Rebalancer triggered due to node join.
Sam: sounds like we need to avoid noisy rebalances during the warmup window. proposal: pin the canary to subset of cache shards (sticky routing) until warmup completes.
ops: we can add a temporary shard-affinity header at the edge for the canary traffic.
deploy-bot: Action: held traffic expansion at 10%. Applied shard-affinity header for canary. Notifying infra and cache teams.
Priya: running a targeted warmup probe with affinity now. results in 60s: p95 back to 90ms.
sre-oncall: good. plan: 1) keep expansion paused, 2) add a pre-rollout hook to check for cache rebalance activity, 3) revert shard-affinity after warmup completes.
Sam: will add preflight check to deploy job. can we also add a synthetic that runs during rebalances to validate p95?
ops: I'll coordinate with cache team to suppress rebalances during deployment windows. ETA 6h for config change.
Sam: decision: hold expansion, use shard-affinity for canary, implement preflight check, schedule cache rebalance suppression. Will update release notes accordingly.
Priya: adding note to INF-2422. Sam: thanks, closing for now.
